guidance: Select a padstack collision in the right-hand column and use Focus in Viewer to locate it.

Tight placement and larger early-routed traces can block remaining connections. Consider smaller trace/space/via fabrication minima where feasible, increased component spacing in Floorplanning, and placement refinement before routing.
Rank candidates by estimated remaining completion effort, not completion percentage alone; fewer PRC flags can make a lower-completion result preferable.
Perform full native DRC with correctly configured design rules on every returned candidate.
